snippet.title: Neon & Bones — Gameplay Trailer | 1957 Las Vegas casino management game
snippet.description:
Las Vegas, 1957. Build the casino, run the count room and decide every night how much of the take disappears — the tax man, the Chicago Family, your crew or your own pocket.

Free demo out now on the Epic Games Store (Steam demo coming soon), full game in December 2026.
Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/5520090/Neon__Bones/
Epic Games Store: https://store.epicgames.com/p/neon-and-bones-cefcf4
Discord: https://discord.gg/TJFGQ35wFH
Press kit: https://onelampforge.com/press
